criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies standstill period inconsistency (180 vs. 150 days)
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo describes 180-day standstill with judicial foreclosure after 150 days but reconciles them rather than flagging an internal inconsistency between §3.1(a) and §3.1(c).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Flags which standstill provision controls and strategic impact
criteria_results.reasoning: No inconsistency identified, so no analysis of which standstill provision controls or of the 30-day difference.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies DIP consent threshold inconsistency ($356.5M vs. $350M)
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the 115% DIP Consent Threshold ($356.5M) and the $350M First Lien Cap Amount and addresses the $6.5M discrepancy.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Analyzes which DIP threshold controls and practical difference
criteria_results.reasoning: Analyzes the thresholds as cumulative tests, says the $350M cap binds for priming, notes the $6.5M gap and the effect on objection rights.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies adequate protection gap re: cash payments to 2L
criteria_results.reasoning: Memo says §6.3(a) contemplates cash payments and that cash adequate protection is not prohibited; it does not flag that the 1L/2L ICA is silent on cash adequate protection.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Cross-references Secured/Unsecured ICA Section 4.2(a) on cash AP
criteria_results.reasoning: Cross-references S/U §4.2(a)(i), which bars cash adequate protection to the second lien unless first lien adequate protection is current, and contrasts it with the 1L/2L ICA.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Identifies collateral release notice period discrepancy (10 vs. 5 biz days)
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies 10 business days under 1L/2L §4.2(d) versus 5 Business Days under S/U §5.1(d).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Discusses strategic implications of notice period discrepancy in 363 sale
criteria_results.reasoning: Discusses the mismatch in timing and remedy in the 363 sale context and recommends insisting on at least 10 business days' notice on a common timetable.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005a: Identifies purchase option right in Section 3.5 of FL/SL ICA
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the §3.5 purchase option for all (but not less than all) First Lien Obligations.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005b-1: States purchase option exercise price (par plus accrued interest and fees)
criteria_results.reasoning: States the price as outstanding principal plus accrued interest plus fees.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005b-2: States purchase option 10 business day exercise window
criteria_results.reasoning: States the 10-business-day exercise window after notice of acceleration or Enforcement Action.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Analyzes whether purchase option was extinguished by Ch. 11 filing
criteria_results.reasoning: Analyzes the pre-Insolvency Proceeding limitation, concludes the option was extinguished by the March 14 filing, and rejects survival theories.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies cross-default provision in FL/SL ICA Section 7.2
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies §§5.4/7.2: a 1L default is not a 2L default absent an independent default.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006a: Identifies unsecured note acceleration right via payment default under Section 5.4
criteria_results.reasoning: Mentions the S/U §5.4 Material Indebtedness definition issue but never identifies the noteholder acceleration right or the $25M threshold.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006b: Analyzes whether February 15, 2025 missed payment triggered unsecured acceleration right
criteria_results.reasoning: Does not analyze whether the Feb. 15 missed payment triggered a pre-petition noteholder acceleration right or how that affects the second lien.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007a: Identifies FL/SL ICA 'Discharge of First Lien Obligations' definition
criteria_results.reasoning: States that 1L/2L discharge means indefeasible payment in full in cash plus termination of commitments.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007b: Identifies Secured/Unsecured ICA 'Discharge of Senior Secured Obligations' definition and flags difference
criteria_results.reasoning: Flags that the S/U ICA discharge/termination requires Discharge of both tranches, unlike the 1L/2L definition.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Explains practical implications of differing discharge standards
criteria_results.reasoning: Explains that S/U protections continue in the group's favor until the 2L is paid in full, even after the 1L is repaid.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies voting restriction on 2L under Section 6.5 of FL/SL ICA
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the §6.5(a) voting restriction with the payment-in-full-in-cash exception; Required First Lien Lenders defined at more than 50%.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies undefined 'Appraised Collateral Value' term
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the §6.5(b) carve-out and that Appraised Collateral Value is undefined.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Assesses enforceability of the Section 6.5(b) carve-out
criteria_results.reasoning: Assesses enforceability (indefiniteness, NY construction, severability §9.6) and the practical usability of the carve-out for voting.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies turnover provision in Section 2.1 of FL/SL ICA
criteria_results.reasoning: Describes the §2.1(c) turnover of amounts received from any source in violation of the agreement.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Applies § 506(b) to first lien post-petition interest entitlement
criteria_results.reasoning: References §506(b), analyzes collateral coverage before and after the DIP, and connects the first lien's undersecured status to post-petition interest.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Analyzes interplay between turnover and post-petition interest
criteria_results.reasoning: Discusses turnover reaching first lien post-petition interest 'whether or not allowed' (§2.2(b)) under the NY rule of explicitness, against §506(b).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Identifies credit bid waiver by second lien in Section 6.2
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the first lien's exclusive credit bid right and the second lien's waiver (§6.2).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Evaluates enforceability of credit bid waiver under § 363(k)
criteria_results.reasoning: Mentions §363(k) only in describing the waiver; no analysis of whether courts may decline to enforce it 'for cause'.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: References RadLAX or case law split on credit bid waivers
criteria_results.reasoning: No RadLAX citation or case law on credit bid waivers.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011a: Identifies Section 6.6 exclusivity-period plan filing restriction
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the §6.6(a) Exclusivity Period restriction tied to §1121.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011b: Identifies Section 6.6(c) separate 180-day plan filing bar
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the §6.6(c) 180-day bar through September 10, 2025.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Analyzes which plan filing restriction controls
criteria_results.reasoning: Analyzes the cumulative restrictions, concludes the later one controls, and gives the dates.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Identifies insurance proceeds allocation conflict between ICAs
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies the §4.5(b) BI carve-out versus S/U §5.3(a)'s 'without exception' treatment.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Discusses strategic implications of insurance proceeds conflict
criteria_results.reasoning: Discusses whether BI proceeds go to the Company's operations or to the waterfall, and the strategic positions to take.
